g.text: Auth 2 of 3 · Session: sign in, rotate and sign out
The same 401 for a nonexistent email
Offers to resend the verification link
The limit is per network address, not per account:
limiting per account would let anyone
lock out a user whose email they know
The refresh token never goes in the body.
The access token does, for the Authorization header
No Authorization header doesn't mean public:
fetch omits cookies unless credentials include
Rotates the token and keeps the family
the access token says who is calling
and the cookie says which family to revoke
